sections.voiceover: Daniel Cottom published an analysis in ELH linking Sherlock Holmes and Dracula. Dr. John Watson compares deductive powers to witchcraft at the beginning of the first canon story. How do these figures connect to bohemian symbolism in imperial Britain?

sections.voiceover: Did you know Sherlock Holmes states that nothing exhausts him except inactivity?

sections.voiceover: Amanda Fransson studied Loren D. Estleman's novel in a 2019 study. Cottom examined both icons as the origin and end of bohemian figures.
